# TinyGres

> TinyGres is a small PostgreSQL-shaped relational database that runs in a
> dedicated browser Worker and stores data in memory or OPFS.

- [Getting started](https://tinygres.org/guides/getting-started/)
- [SQL compatibility](https://tinygres.org/guides/sql-compatibility/)
- [API reference](https://tinygres.org/api/)
- [Demos](https://tinygres.org/demos/)
- [Release notes](https://tinygres.org/guides/releases/)
- [Agent guide](https://tinygres.org/guides/agents-guide/)
- [Repository](https://github.com/tinyplex/tinygres)
